status: single natural scene ROI comparison using equation mirrors; no quality gate

pair.source_dataset: Middlebury registered EOS 5D natural-scene RAW/JPEG pair
pair.reference_role: camera rendition, not calibrated color truth
pair.transfer: both measured as encoded sRGB; source converted from dataset linear RAW with sRGB OETF

roi_review.source_only_review: Both polygons lie within the visible white pendant shade surfaces in the source overlay. The sampled masks do not visibly include the hanging cords, background, or obvious scene edges. This is an analyst visual review, not independent annotation or proof of neutral material.

conditions.metrics: encoded-sRGB error; Lab D65/2-degree DeltaE76 on [0,1]-clipped values; mean-vector chroma/hue and pixel chroma distribution
conditions.interpretation: camera-JPEG closeness and source-relative change are separate; no thresholds or winner

implementation.candidate_origin: pre-existing RD7 Python equation-mirror arrays; no C++ differential

visual_review.status: generated after source-only ROI acceptance; exploratory and unblinded

limitations: camera JPEG is processed reference, not ground truth
ROI manually drawn by one analyst
no Core execution, ICC/HDR, alpha, product path, GPU parity, independent review, or performance
